enabled.description: Enable or disable the mDNS responder functionality.

hostname.description: Custom mDNS hostname to advertise. Leave empty to use the system hostname.

domain.description: Domain suffix for mDNS names (must be 'local' for standard mDNS).

interface.description: Network interface to use (e.g., 'eth0'). Leave empty to use all interfaces.

port.description: UDP port for mDNS traffic. Must be 5353 for standard compliance.

nsec_cache.description: Enable aggressive NSEC record caching for negative responses.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to stdout/stderr.

services.description: List of services to advertise via mDNS.

name.description: Instance name for the service (e.g., 'My Website').

metadata.description: Key-value pairs for DNS TXT records (e.g., {'path': '/'}).
